# 332_R7UX.9 — token-level chat streaming, part 2: render `chat.token` deltas live (BL-99b)

## What

BL-99 part 2 — the client half of ADR-137. While a `chat_turn` run is in flight, the chat panel
now renders `chat.token` deltas into the pending turn's bubble **incrementally**: an inert
`[data-chat-stream]` text node inside the assistant bubble fills as tokens arrive
(`data-streaming="true"` styling — dashed border, no markdown parse), then unmounts the instant
the terminal twin refetch lands the canonical `reply`, which wins unconditionally. Zero-token
turns render exactly as before.

**Render contract implemented** (ADR-137's client clause):

- **Append-by-turnId, dedup-by-seq** — deltas buffer into a `Map<seq, text>`; replayed seqs
  overwrite idempotently and out-of-order frames concat in seq order, so a mid-flight reconnect's
  replay can't corrupt the stream.
- **rAF coalescing** — one `streamed` state write per animation frame regardless of event rate.
- **Canonical swap** — `reply != null` always wins over the stream node; a failed/aborted turn
  clears it. The stream binds by `runId` to the transcript row the twin refetches land —
  `maxConcurrentStreamNodes: 1` proven live.
- **Visibility** — the stream node is `aria-hidden`; the live region still announces the
  canonical reply once at completion.

## Fixed on the way

- `chat-live.tsx`'s SSE tail used `EventSource.onmessage`, which **never fires on this stream** —
  `formatSse` emits named frames (`event: chat.token`). The tail now binds
  `addEventListener` per type (feed.ts's existing pattern). The `run.state_changed` terminal
  check now reads `payload.to` (the event is per-transition).
- `formatFeedRow` guarded against `maps.t` being undefined (throws inside the handler).
